note: Values are what the generator was given. Each recording was decoded once; the ATSC counts were measured with a Reed-Solomon stage that only detected errors (no correction), so a correcting decoder must meet them with margin. Tolerances are the acceptance limits of specs/tvterr.md section 10; packet counts are lower bounds over the whole recording; flagged_share_max is the largest share of delivered packets that may carry the transport_error_indicator.

packets.description: packet n: byte0 0x47; bytes1-2 0x01 0x00 (PID 0x100, no error, no PUSI); byte3 0x10 | (n mod 16) (payload only, continuity counter n mod 16); bytes4-7 n as a 32-bit big-endian number; byte i for i = 8..187 = (7 n + 13 i) mod 256
packets.check: every packet delivered without the transport_error_indicator must match this pattern for its own n; n must increase by exactly 1 between consecutive delivered packets except across packets flagged in error
